dialogue_text.player_loss: Return when your plan has a second line.

trainers.lesson: Sturdy holds one more turn: a single strong hit is not a plan.

dialogue_text.pre: Every stone in this hall was squared by hand. Let's see how square you are.
dialogue_text.player_win: Cut clean. The foreman will want to see that.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Rough edges. Go back down and dress them.

trainers.lesson: Rock Tomb slows the answer you were counting on.

dialogue_text.pre: You came over the wall. Most people take the stack that goes nowhere.
dialogue_text.player_win: Good climbing, better battling. Brock is through the lit slot.
dialogue_text.player_loss: The wall's still there. Climb it again when you're ready.

trainers.lesson: Rapid Spin and Rock Polish buy speed: hit before the stone gets going.

dialogue_text.pre: Last cart before the boss. Everything you brought up here, I haul back down.
dialogue_text.player_win: Fair load. Brock's just up the ladder. Mind the soot.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Too heavy for you yet. Back down the beams with you.

trainers.lesson: Swift Swim and priority: the water moves first unless you make it wait.

dialogue_text.pre: Nobody walks up to Misty's door. Whatever brought you, the water decides the rest.
dialogue_text.player_win: You keep your head above it. Go on in.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Swim back to the shallows and catch your breath.

trainers.lesson: Recover undoes chip damage: hit hard or not at all.

dialogue_text.pre: Last check before the pool. Misty doesn't wait for anyone who can't keep up.
dialogue_text.player_win: Strong strokes. She's at the far rim.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Out of the water. Rest, then try again.

trainers.lesson: Thunder Wave first, damage second: paralysis is the real attack.

dialogue_text.pre: Mind the tower, it's live. So am I.
dialogue_text.player_win: Clean break in the circuit. Up you go.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Tripped the breaker. Reset and come back.

trainers.lesson: Charge Beam builds: end it before the third turn.

dialogue_text.pre: Three runs and only one of them is carrying. Did you read which?
dialogue_text.player_win: You can read a board. The Lieutenant's past the duct.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Grounded. Walk the catwalk again and think.

trainers.lesson: Electro Ball hits harder the faster it is: slow it down or outpace it.

dialogue_text.pre: You walked the whole catwalk to get here. The cable run is mine.
dialogue_text.player_win: Line's yours. Keep your hands off the rails on the way over.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Tripped the breaker. Reset and come back along the catwalk.

trainers.lesson: Powders are the threat; the damage is just weather.

dialogue_text.pre: Mind the beds. Mind me, too.
dialogue_text.player_win: You walk the canopy like you planted it.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Wilted. Take some sun and come back up.

trainers.lesson: Regenerator and Leech Seed: a slow fight favours the garden.

dialogue_text.pre: One line of piers still has its second stone. You saw which?
dialogue_text.player_win: Erika is in the court below. Drop carefully.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Down in the mulch again. The ladder is by the wall.

trainers.lesson: Stun Spore is the plan, not the damage: keep a cure or a switch ready.

dialogue_text.pre: Nobody gets up the living bough without a scratch. Let's give you one.
dialogue_text.player_win: Steady footing. The high canopy is all yours.
dialogue_text.player_loss: The bough threw you. Breathe, and climb it again.

trainers.lesson: Sucker Punch punishes the slow, careful setup.

dialogue_text.pre: You came in loud. Koga will have heard you already.
dialogue_text.player_win: Quieter than you look. Take the reed stair.
dialogue_text.player_loss: The fen keeps what it catches. Dry off and try again.

trainers.lesson: Toxic is a clock: every switch spends your time.

dialogue_text.pre: The tank is breathing. Do you know where it comes up?
dialogue_text.player_win: You read the water. The flue's below.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Too long under. Breathe, then come back.

trainers.lesson: Toxic Spikes and a pivot: the damage comes on entry.

dialogue_text.pre: Up the flue and still standing. Koga will be pleased, if you get past me.
dialogue_text.player_win: Go on. He has been watching you since the door.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Back down the chute. The fen is patient.

trainers.lesson: Calm Mind turns a slow special attacker into a wall: break it early.

dialogue_text.pre: Three of the stacks stop short. One doesn't. You knew that before you came in.
dialogue_text.player_win: You read well. The gallery is above.
dialogue_text.player_loss: You trusted the wrong stack. Read again.

trainers.lesson: Hypnosis misses often; a team that plans for sleep never needs luck.

dialogue_text.pre: The eye in the arch is looking at you, not me.
dialogue_text.player_win: You see clearly. The turret ladder is north.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Your eyes lied to you. Rest them.

trainers.lesson: Trick Room-style speed control: the slow side moves first here.

dialogue_text.pre: One more lens before hers. Look through me first.
dialogue_text.player_win: Sabrina is waiting at the top. She knew you would come.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Fogged. Come back when you can see.

trainers.lesson: Calm Mind stacks every turn it is left alone: pressure it early.

dialogue_text.pre: The gallery's west walk is shelved by thought. You'll need yours.
dialogue_text.player_win: Your mind held. The north arm is ahead.
dialogue_text.player_loss: You lost the thread. Go back to the stacks and find it.

trainers.lesson: Flame Charge snowballs: stop the first speed boost.

dialogue_text.pre: The spoil steps are hot. So's my team.
dialogue_text.player_win: You'll do. Mind the broken flight, it goes nowhere.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Cool off by the furnace and try again.

trainers.lesson: Nasty Plot plus a fast Fire type: pressure it before it sets up.

dialogue_text.pre: The gantry is the only way up. I'm the only way past it.
dialogue_text.player_win: Readings are good. Up to the gallery.
dialogue_text.player_loss: The vent was hotter than you. Down you go.

trainers.lesson: Sun boosts every Fire move: change the weather or lose the race.

dialogue_text.pre: Four hoods, one breathing. You have to get past me to pick.
dialogue_text.player_win: The leap is yours. Blaine is below the flue.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Wrong hood. The geyser will bring you back up.

trainers.lesson: Flame Charge speeds it up with every hit: answer the first one.

dialogue_text.pre: Halfway up the gantry is where the heat starts. Keep climbing if you can.
dialogue_text.player_win: You took the heat. The gallery's at the top.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Burned out on the stair. Cool off and come back up.

trainers.lesson: Sand Stream chip and Sand Rush: the field fights for them.

dialogue_text.pre: You found the sap. Most stand in the yard waiting for a door.
dialogue_text.player_win: Down the heading, then. Mind the shoring.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Cave-in. Climb out and come back down.

trainers.lesson: Dig dodges a turn: use it to switch, not to wait.

dialogue_text.pre: The heading's shored for one. You'll fight me in it.
dialogue_text.player_win: Through, then. The tower stair is round the corner.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Back to the sap. The drill starts over.

trainers.lesson: Rock Slide flinches and Lightning Rod: plan around both.

dialogue_text.pre: Nobody comes up the stair without coming past me.
dialogue_text.player_win: Up the stair. The walk is open.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Back to the drift. Try the stair again when you can.

trainers.lesson: Sheer Force and Earth Power: the last guard hits like the boss.

dialogue_text.pre: The gate walk is mine. The Boss sees everything from here.
dialogue_text.player_win: You held the line. He's at the end of the walk.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Back to the yard. The drill starts over.
